      public TwoFluidConservationEquations.TransactionalEvaluation getMidpointEvaluation()
      Compatibility accessor for the selected-time evaluation. It is at the midpoint for the default method and at the endpoint for backward Euler.
      Returns:
      immutable exact derivatives and transport ledger
